subject: Delete _app/_gatetest/ — throwaway probe I could not remove
description:
Created 2026-08-30 to prove the HEXOS-0 omission gate exits non-zero on a new launchable surface (it did: exit 1 present, exit 0 absent). Should never have been written under _app, the deployed web root. rm and mv are both denied to the agent session by the never-destroy policy. Neutralised to a bare redirect to / so it is harmless if it ships. Operator: rm -rf _app/_gatetest
[2026-09-02 13:12] Verified 2026-09-02: this debris CANNOT reach production. firebase.json hosting ignore already lists _gatetest/** and _chris_gate_probe_tmp/**, and the third file (_chris_tabcomplete_probe_tmp.js, left by the Chris tab-completion probe) sits at repo ROOT, outside public:_app. So this is tidiness, not a production risk, and it is not urgent. Still needs the operator: rm is denied to me and to both review agents. Full list: _app/_gatetest/, _app/_chris_gate_probe_tmp/, _chris_tabcomplete_probe_tmp.js.
[2026-09-03 17:24] Add _chris_probe1_tmp.js (repo root) to the sweep; Chris disclosed creating it during the round-4 gate and rm was denied to him as it is to me. Also _tools/hexos/_reviewer_probe_tmp.test.js and three older _chris_*_tmp files in _tools/hexos, which git status does NOT show because _tools is gitignored (see taskboard 337). None can reach production or the deploy chain: hosting ignores the _app ones, and post-verify names each hexos gate explicitly rather than globbing *.test.js, both verified.
[2026-09-03 17:43] Chris (re-gate at 562cf9e62) also left debris, rm denied: _tools/hexos/_chris_extended_probe_tmp.js, _tools/hexos/_chris_probe_out_tmp.txt, _tools/hexos/_chris_probe_out2_tmp.txt (repo root: _chris_gate_probe2_tmp.js, _chris_gate_probe3_tmp.js -- dead ends, superseded once __dirname-relative paths were fixed). Same containment as the rest of this sweep: the root two sit outside public:_app, and the _tools/hexos ones cannot reach post-verify since it names each gate explicitly rather than globbing.
[2026-09-06 03:08] ARCHIVED 2026-09-05 to _tools/_archive/gatetest-328/, sha256 verified identical, so removal is now a no-loss operation whenever the operator authorises it. Confirmed still 404 in production: firebase.json ignores _* and _*/**, so an underscore-prefixed directory in the web root is structurally never served. It is local debris, not an exposure. rm remains denied to me by the permission layer, which is correct under the archive-never-destroy rule; the copy exists so the eventual delete costs nothing.
